description: Returns, adds, updates, and removes Atlas Stream Processing Workspaces. The DataProcessRegion.Region property can be updated after creation. Other properties (WorkspaceName, ProjectId, Profile, StreamConfig, DataProcessRegion.CloudProvider) are create-only and require resource replacement to change.. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources.git

BaseStreamsRegion.description: Name of the cloud provider region hosting Atlas Stream Processing.
BaseStreamsRegion.title: MongoDBAtlasStreamWorkspaceBaseStreamsRegionDefinition

StreamsDataProcessRegion.description: Information about the cloud provider region in which MongoDB Cloud processes the stream.

CloudProvider.description: Label that identifies the cloud service provider where MongoDB Cloud performs stream processing. For CloudFormation, this is restricted to AWS only.

StreamsDataProcessRegion.title: MongoDBAtlasStreamWorkspaceStreamsDataProcessRegionDefinition

StreamConfig.description: Configuration options for an Atlas Stream Processing Workspace.

Tier.description: Selected tier for the Stream Workspace. Configures Memory / VCPU allowances. Valid values: SP2, SP5, SP10, SP30, SP50.

MaxTierSize.description: Max tier size for the Stream Workspace. Configures Memory / VCPU allowances. Valid values: SP2, SP5, SP10, SP30, SP50.

StreamConfig.title: MongoDBAtlasStreamWorkspaceStreamConfigDefinition

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml).

WorkspaceName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the stream workspace.

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the project.

title: MongoDBAtlasStreamWorkspaceProperties
